# Silverwing

Silverwing is a barely seen Pegasus stallion from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for a pale silvery-gray coat and light blue-gray mane in the aftermath of Ponyville’s successful water-lifting tornado. The character index lists white eyes (the visible eye color may reflect the expression in the capture). His cutie mark is not established by the sources I found.

- **Name and continuity:** Silverwing is a fandom identification name used for a character design seen in the G4 television series. No official naming, production label, merchandise name, alternate identity, or origin of the fan name was verified. [Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies).
